Package com.example.volt.search

Class DestinationsSearchAdapter

java.lang.Object
android.widget.BaseAdapter
android.widget.ArrayAdapter<Destination>
com.example.volt.search.DestinationsSearchAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Adapter, Filterable, ListAdapter, SpinnerAdapter, ThemedSpinnerAdapter
public class DestinationsSearchAdapter extends ArrayAdapter<Destination>
An adapter that manages a list of Destinations objects for display in a ListView based on a filter.

Representation Invariant:

  • originalDestinations != null
  • filteredDestinations != null
  • foreach element e in filteredDestinations: e is in originalDestinations

Abstraction Function:

DestinationsSearchAdapter dsa represents a bridge that links Destinations to the ListView such that:
  • dsa.originalDestinations represents the collection of all Destinations.
  • dsa.filteredDestinations represents a collection of Destinations after applying a filter.
